_comment: Enemy factions and where they spawn. behaviour: aggro (range they notice you), range (distance they like to fight at), flee (core HP fraction they run at; 0 = never), leash (how far they chase from home). ships: XP and credits per kill. loot: rolled per kill; partSalvage: chance each intact part drops as a salvageable part. spawns.<system>.nests: packs launched from that system's nests (systems.json nests: where each orbits), `packs` out at once while a pilot is near, roaming `roam` round it and chasing no further than `leash`; a wiped-out pack is replaced after `respawnSeconds`, and a group's own `respawnSeconds` and `limit` keep its heavies rare. A system's own `groups` roam free only if its `packs` > 0; otherwise they're just who its raids and events send.

scrapborn.name: Scrapborn
scrapborn.description: Feral machines heaping greyseam into nests in Sol's outer Drift. A fault that happens to some cores, rarely, the yards say; every pilot has a theory. Heavy, slow and half blind. Good practice, fair pay.

helios.name: Helios Drones
helios.description: Maintenance drones strayed from the Helios Directorate's Array: slow, half-blind, and armed with welding torches. They keep a schedule nobody at the Array wrote. Harmless unless you start it, and not much even then.

sol._comment: Inner Sol (systems.json regions) is safe: the system-wide packs are passive, and hostiles never come in after pilots there. Middle Sol has the Lanes, the Drift and the Graveyard; the Reaches are hostile, in better plate.

ashfall_cavern._comment: The Pyreclast's den (docs/bosses/rework-2026-11.md 9.2-9.3): packs posted at hidden nests (systems.json, fixed: orbit period 0), anchored round them in open ground: Slag Ray pairs and Clinker + Ray packs along the canyon, the Kiln's own four (two Clinkers on its floor, two Rays at its tunnel). The basin and the vault's mouth stay clear.

ashfall._comment: Ashfall is a starter system, but the Redtooth are aggressive: they come for anyone they see near their digs. Everything here launches from a nest; its own groups are who raids and events send. Their outpost (bosses.json boss_redtooth_hold) sits in the belt.

custom._comment: Custom enemies (docs/enemies/custom-roster.md; server/src/game/custom): `types` puts a design (data/ships/blueprints/enemy, its moves common/src/bodies/custom) in a ship type's place wherever it spawns; each design's `range`/`reach` (its fighting range, and how far its moves reach), `hp` per destroyable piece and its moves' and guns' numbers at Mk I, `firepower` for ratings. A grade scales hp and damage by `grades` (Mk I-V) instead of regrading its materials; elites take rules.eliteHp too. Faction hpScale/damageScale don't apply: these numbers are the design's own.

rules.gradeCredits_comment: kill credits are the ship's credits × this by the enemy's grade (Mk I-V), rising with grade (XP scales by gradeReward instead). The ship types already pay more the deadlier their systems (a skiff 9, a Maw colossus 493): this only adds to that, so a Mk I kill pays about what mining in Sol does after repairs and nothing tougher ever pays less
